prompt_edits: Require every register entry to carry a stable UUID and the full untruncated quoted clause, including the exact operator and enough surrounding context to reproduce the claim; the current 300-character truncation makes independent adjudication impossible for many entries.

Require a per-finding verification ledger containing artifact hash, PDF page, printed page, source span, recomputation or rendered-page evidence, and an explicit NOT VERIFIED marker when the reviewer did not actually inspect the source; cross-critique must not adjudicate from summary text alone.

Require any refile of a round-1 rejected class to cite the new primary evidence that distinguishes it from the previously confirmed benign reading; otherwise the entry should be automatically marked as a false positive.
